description: Altria Group is one of the world’s largest tobacco companies, holding a diverse portfolio across combustible tobacco products, such as those made by Philip Morris USA, as well as smoke-free alternatives, like those from Njoy. Altria is also invested in complementary assets such as beer behemoth AB InBev and cannabinoid company Cronos Group. Altria’s focus is to support consumers as they move beyond smoking and transition to potentially less harmful choices.

title: Altria Group

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Manufacturing and Production
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Altria has admirable workplace flexibility, and Altria was trailblazing the path of workplace flexibility even before COVID started. Those who are able to do their jobs fully remotely can work remotely without judgement, and those with roles that sometimes need to be in person (such as engineering) are still given the flexibility to work hybrid if they don't need to be in person that day. This aspect of the culture alone has been a game changer for me and many of my coworkers—especially those who would have long commutes, those who are parents, those who have health conditions, and those who have pets—and it has led to increases in productivity, better retention, and greater employee satisfaction."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Manufacturing and Production
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Altria is incredible place to work. I have had the fortunate experience to always have great supervisors/bosses. The leadership team at Altria throughout the years has been outstanding. I have made the most incredible friendships here. The people are wonderful and I have never met an employee/colleague that if you reached out and asked for help, they didn't provide it, get you to the right resource, etc."

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Millennials
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Altria is more than a company—it feels like a family to me. Managers are committed to inclusion, and they have always been supportive in helping me reach my full potential. My peers are also supportive in helping me to continuously learn and grow so that we can reach our full potential as a team. At the highest level, it's the people and leadership that make this place a great place to work."
